blocks.x: The Chief Executive Officer mandate at Dataq Software: keep deliveries predictable, keep evidence honest, and stay personally reachable to the clients those deliveries serve.

The part that survives audit is the boring part: evidence is captured where the work happens, not reconstructed later for the enterprise at scale, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence.
